name: clypmint-broll
description: B-roll of anything for your agent: real photos and footage of the person, company, place or event a script names, checked by a vision model, with the rights.

interface.shortDescription: B-roll of anything for your videos
interface.longDescription: Find real photos and footage of the exact person, company, product, place or event a script names. One search covers Wikimedia Commons, NASA, the Internet Archive, the Library of Congress, Openverse and official channels, and web mode finds the moment inside a YouTube video. A vision model checks every shot, and every shot comes with its license and credit line. Needs a Clypmint API key in CLYPMINT_API_KEY.
defaultPrompt: Find b-roll for every name in this script.
Get a 4 second clip of the Saturn V launch.
Find a photo of Sam Altman I can use commercially.
